conditions: Clearance C2 of plan post-1.3.0-h3-retire-op-2026 (phase 3, steps 10 and 11), recorded before the removal (C-5). The operator retires the decision verify key op-2026 from this repository's main line by deleting exactly two tracked files, .github/agents/references/authorized-verify-keys/op-2026.pub.pem and .codex/agents/references/authorized-verify-keys/op-2026.pub.pem, each with sha256 08f69c5d0e899bd26b26deb6f9f3af9b1a65a9c5e0ee25733769cc1ea3e70e7b, by running operator script references/plans/archive/2026-W48/operator/34-remove-op-2026.sh, tracked copy sha256 53f0ee5c549d9f8551a3de7dce27a43a91eac7b8d9cf8f54de5898bc78ec3f6f (the operator's runnable copy differs from it only on the two lines marked '# @ph', and the script checks that before it removes anything). The row's effect_targets is empty on purpose: agentteams 1.3.0 refuses, at signing and at the gate, any decision whose write target lies in a verify-key store (categorically non-eligible), so the two files are named here and the effect is declared as destructive only. It applies to main at phase 2's merge commit 8e827f9311b0a4b59e16a0c27659425833fb5baf (pull request #275, which re-bound the branch-deletion exception to its opr-2026-11 row; CI green on main at that commit). The removal revokes 29 rows signed only with op-2026: 27 in the .github log and 2 in the .codex log. Kept in force by a later opr-2026-11 row of the same id: release-policy-1.0 (both logs), management-roster-enroll:infrastructure-management, s10-first-party-releases-2026-11, term-index-2026-11, release-line-agentteams-1.2 and repo-setting:delete-branch-on-merge:jlcatonjr/researchteam. Lapsing, as ruled: s10-release-key-exemption, s10-release-key-exemption-1.1, release-line-agentteams-1.1, s10-release-cooldown-deprecated, s10-release-cooldown-restored, s10-cooldown-exempt:jlcatonjr/agentteams, fleet-agent-pilot-2026-11 (the Claude GitHub App authorization pilot), codex-orchestrator-only-native-render (both logs), and the thirteen pin rows pin-agentteams-v1.0.0-rc.12, -v1.0.0-rc.13, -v1.0.0-rc.14, -v1.0.0, -v1.0.7, -v1.1.0-rc.2, -v1.1.0-rc.6, -v1.1.0-rc.7, -v1.1.0-rc.11, -v1.1.0-rc.15, -v1.1.0-rc.16, -v1.1.0 and -v1.1.1. The registry's two sunset entries then point at rows that no longer verify; they are inert history and are left as they are. Operator's answers (picker, 2026-11-25): P2 'Let both lapse' (the two cooldown rows are not signed again; docs/release-policy.md marks them as history; the next cut script stops matching s10-release-cooldown-restored as text, blocking for that cut); P3 'Retire the key first' (the retirement does not wait for H4; the App has no authorization in this repository from the removal until H4's row, a new id under opr-2026-11, never a re-sign of the pilot); P4 'Leave them alone' (release/1.0, release/1.1 and release/1.2 keep trusting op-2026 and nothing is opened against them; a pull request that brings op-2026 back onto main is a HALT). Conditions at the run: the autosync paused from the run to the merge and no autosync pull request open (C4); the operator confirms in the script that the App is idle or suspended (C3); no H4 signature between the run and the merge; the operator confirms the deletion in the script and in the picker (S-4); if any check after the removal fails, both files are restored from git and nothing is committed; the test checks pass on the pull request head and @security's PASS names the two paths before the merge (PS-2); the private key op-2026 stays with the operator, offline, and is never used for a main row again (C5). Nothing is relaxed and nothing is granted.
